payload.decision_text:
SUPERSEDE — composed design only. I reviewed the Quirk Agent Workforce composed v0.2.1 design at exact head 476eed0130a2e76241fcc9166594f24d5966a5af, tree 762d45bbd370c6153d45361ace9785562437a310, and reconciliation payload digest sha256:65764afc920a26a5338145ae2c06fe73533705f7086e477d145cb87779f46d59.

I supersede quirk.agent-workforce.dual-plane-design@0.1.0 solely as the effective approved design specification with the immutable composition of:

1. v0.1.0 at commit ab031a7e5c51704acaf15da0f4f705cc6f6a8531 and digest sha256:9c572e32260efd271e38b152bd4fb93340a5fd4fd2c41d5206672bc098c99a6a; and
2. the v0.2.1 reconciliation at exact head, tree and digest identified above.

The v0.1 artifact remains immutable, incorporated and auditable. The v0.2.1 reconciliation controls only where the documents conflict, including the five-plane operating separation, five non-interchangeable grant kinds, external approval and supersession receipts, provider-resource containment, publication authority, action-readiness requirements and successor adversarial fixtures.

This preserves exactly eleven candidate roles and the separate incumbent Sync Steward. It does not admit, activate, install, project or invoke any role or component.

This decision does not authorize implementation planning, manifests, GitHub profiles, prompts, skills, connectors, provider or account access, model execution, runtime, deployment, database or Supabase effects, network or domain changes, telemetry operations, product claims, Preference Graph access or mutation, pull-request creation, review, merge, release or publication.

Every downstream action remains separately gated by its exact human decision, component admissions, applicable typed-grant intersection, ActionReadinessRecord, rollback obligations and execution receipt. Any change to either composed payload, the reviewed head, tree, file scope or digest requires fresh human review.
